dashboard.label: TA-netqual Overview
dashboard.description: Collects per-interface link quality from /sys/class/net and /proc/net/dev: carrier/operstate, negotiated speed, MTU, cumulative RX/TX error and drop counters per physical

search.query: index=main sourcetype="netqual:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="netqual.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="netqual:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
